evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before we talk about your move and before I start building your estimate, do you have any concerns or anything important for you that you wanna talk about for the move?' — a clean, recognizable version of the agenda question, asked before any real logistics probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised three real concerns (antique sewing machine wanting to be lifted not wheeled, a heavy chest freezer, a fragile electric piano) — rep followed up with specifics (asked the sewing machine's exact weight vs. the 300lb threshold, confirmed appliance disconnect/reconnect service, noted crew handling instructions for all three), scored full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we are time based... it'll all depend on how well prepared you are' plus proactively over-estimating the hours at the customer's request for safety margin — partial 'estimate is a window' credit; no rate-lock/100k line, no explicit 'beats it, pay less' statement, no self-prep tip.

top_strength: Asked the agenda question early and then genuinely worked through three distinct heavy/fragile-item concerns with specifics (weight thresholds, appliance handling) — plus flexibly padded the estimate when the customer explained her husband's employer needed a safe number, building real trust.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee and Communication (Sheets 3 & 4) were never mentioned anywhere in this 24-minute call — a missed differentiator on a call this thorough and this long.
